generalAbilities.name: Mist Vision
generalAbilities.description: Fog and mist don't impair a sky dragon's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from fog and mist.

defensiveAbilities.name: Countered by Fire
defensiveAbilities.description:
If the sky dragon takes fire damage, the elemental magic of metal within them is tempered. Until the end of their next turn, they take a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and AC, and their jaws Strikes don't deal electricity damage. This limitation ends if the dragon uses Breath Weapon.

Effect: Countered by Fire

defensiveAbilities.name: Fed by Earth
defensiveAbilities.description: When a sky dragon is targeted by an earth spell or effect, they leave a cloud of pulverized dust and gravel that swirls in the eddies of the dragon's flight. For 1 minute, the dragon is Concealed while flying.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 26 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon shoots a ball of electricity that deals 5d12 Electricity Damage damage in a 20ft Burst within 40 feet (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save).

They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Coiling Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d8+7) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Perfected Flight
offensiveAbilities.description: A sky dragon can hover in place without spending an action, and they automatically succeed at all Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv1spells.name: Feather Fall
lv1spells.description:
Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

lv1spells.name: Gust of Wind
lv1spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
lv1spells.description:
A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked Prone. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked Prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

lv2spells.name: Invisibility
lv2spells.description:
Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes Invisible. This makes it Undetected to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it Hidden to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.
